svg.aria-label: ChordKu song view with callouts: toolbar with transpose, capo and notation, synced chord chart with sections, floating chord diagram panel, stem mixer and transport bar
svg.text: Everything about the display is a view: the analysis is stored at concert pitch and never changes.
Transpose moves the sound (audio is pitch-shifted along).
A capo only changes the printed shapes. Suggestions are ranked
by how easy the resulting chords are.
One cell per beat. Chord changes snap to the bar grid;
the beat that is sounding lights up. Click to seek, or switch
to Fix chords and pick one of the recogniser's alternatives.
Floating diagrams stay visible while the chart scrolls:
guitar, ukulele, piano or all three, current chord and the
next ones. Drag it anywhere, tap for another voicing.
Stems from htdemucs: mute the singer, solo the bass.
Sources are sample-locked; phones get two light mono stems.
Slow down to 50 % without changing pitch, loop a section
or an A-B range. Export: ChordPro, text, PDF.
